text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Hanshin J.F. arrives, and Sweep Tosho grows frustrated with Air Groove's endless fretting.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She pouts, but instead of treating her like a child, I let her know that I believe in her and send her off to race.
